title: Driven Oscillator Interactive MicroSim
description: Interactive simulation showing how a driven oscillator responds to different driving frequencies, demonstrating resonance when the driving frequency matches the natural frequency. Users can adjust driving frequency, force amplitude, and damping to observe steady-state amplitude and phase relationships.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: physics
oscillations
resonance
driven harmonic motion
damping
frequency response
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of driven oscillator interactive
Explore driven oscillator interactive through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of driven oscillator interactive to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on driven oscillator interactive
